title: A sharp inverse theorem for the quadratic large sieve
summary: We prove that if $A\subseteq[N]$, $|A|\gg\sqrt N$, and $|A_p|\le p/2+O(1)$ for every prime $p\ll \log N$, then $A$ contains at least $\exp\left(c\sqrt{\log N}/\log\log N\right)$ elements in the image of a single integral quadratic $m\pm x^2$. This significantly improves Hanson's logarithmic lower bound, while requiring the residue restriction only for primes $p\ll\log N$. Our proof uses a new weighted entropy argument inspired by our previous work \href{https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17487}{arXiv:2606.17487} with Sheffer.
